# A customer with a custom key whose value is written without quotes and starts with `#`.
#
# What this fixture produces: customer C-COLOUR, Acme, in CAD, with the custom
# key `colour` holding the text `#ff0000`. A `#` starts a typed literal such as
# `#True` or `#None`, and `#ff0000` is none of them, so it is read as the text
# it is.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_an_unquoted_value_starting_with_a_hash_is_read_as_text.py.
customer "C-COLOUR"
	name: "Acme"
	currency: CAD
	colour: #ff0000
